# Overview

Composite report for the US birth certificates Down syndrome study.

::: {.callout-note}
This Quarto book is a placeholder. Individual model chapters are wired in

## Model variants

Model artefacts live under `output/models/<model_id>-<run_config>/` and
are produced by `scripts/fit_model.py`. Per-model technical reports are
rendered from `docs/models/<model_id>/index.qmd`.
